method: python requests, one GET per page, robots.txt respected (RFC 9309), 4 s between requests to a host, User-Agent: ECI-RealCorpus/0.1 (ground truth for an open-source competitive-intelligence tool; +https://github.com/SamJ12138/AI-E-commerce-Competitive-Intelligence-Tool)
notes: Replaces pfrankmd.com (a dermatology clinic site, not a store) in sites.txt and the corpus.
robots.txt disallows /policies/, so the Shopify policy pages were not read; shipping and returns terms come from /pages/faqs and /pages/returns-exchanges.
custom-mens-cologne-set was read but is not used as a ground-truth product: it is a bundle builder whose page shows 'Product price: $0.00' while its JSON-LD says 170.0.

platform.evidence: robots.txt '# we use Shopify as our ecommerce platform'; cdn.shopify.com assets, apple-pay-shop-capabilities and shopify-features scripts in the homepage HTML

free_shipping_threshold.evidence: Luxury shipping is free for US domestic orders over $100 (excludes gift cards); 'Free luxury shipping on US orders $100+' on collection and product pages; product JSON-LD freeShippingThreshold 100.00

return_days.evidence: We offer full refunds (including shipping) as long as our payment processor allows it (usually up to 120 days from the date of purchase). After 120 days, we can do a refund as store credit. Product pages: 'Full refund up to 120 days from order'

free_returns.evidence: We will provide you with a complimentary return label; returns page: full refunds (including shipping); product JSON-LD returnFees FreeReturn

We also accept Beardbrand Gift Cards, Shopify Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal.' No payment icons on the pages read.

review_platform.evidence: Judge.me app block and jdgm-widget markup; '(26 reviews)' next to the price

has_loyalty.evidence: Alliance: 'When you purchase directly from Beardbrand three times or spend $150 on a single order, you'll receive an email invite to become a member'; members get free standard shipping on domestic orders, $5 off premium shipping, pre-market product access (also sold for a one-time $90)
has_loyalty.note: a membership earned by repeat purchases, not a points program; the homepage only shows the menu entry 'Alliance Membership'
